name: print-social-home-decor-posts-black-and-white-with-high-contrast-italic-serif
title: Home decor pack in black and white with huge high-contrast italic serif and a wavy line
whatItIs: Ten square posts alternating black and white with oversized high-contrast italic serif phrases ('Making comfortable spaces', 'Home sweet home'), a small '.h.' monogram, circle outlines, a squiggle line and small interior photos of plants and sofas.
whatItMeans: Elegant and editorial; giant italics feel like a design magazine cover.
techniques: Let a huge italic serif phrase fill the post.
Use a tiny monogram as the only branding.
Add a single wavy line as decoration.

vocabulary.definition: A serif with very thick and thin strokes, like Didone.
